English: Wild Cocoa Stand
A primitive, makeshift shelter where wild cocoa pods are gathered and basic processing begins. The first step in settling a cocoa-rich region.
Planted Grove
A grove where cocoa saplings are planted in neat rows, allowing for steady cultivation and more predictable harvests.
Fenced Orchard
A guarded orchard with simple wooden fences to protect young cocoa trees from wild animals and theft, improving yields and security.
Fermentation Hut
A specialized hut for fermenting cocoa beans, producing higher-quality cocoa and providing a minor prestige boost for the clan.
Expanded Grove
A greatly enlarged cocoa grove, with improved irrigation and dedicated labor, supporting a much larger population and workforce.
Walled Orchard
A fortified orchard surrounded by sturdy walls, with watch posts and organized labor, ensuring both security and efficient production.
Cocoa Market Pavilion
A bustling market center devoted to cocoa trade, drawing merchants and boosting the local economy and supply capabilities for the horde.
Syrup Hall
A grand hall for the processing and storage of rich cocoa syrup, providing not only economic wealth but also enhancing clan unity and prestige.
Merchants Grove
A prestigious district where the cocoa trade is managed by experienced merchants, drawing traders from distant lands and boosting the realms influence and mobility.
Mesoamerican Cocoa Estate
A vast, legendary estate dedicated to cocoa, with fortified storage, skilled labor, and a vibrant trading hub rivaling any in Mesoamerica. The pride of the clan, and a symbol of power and prosperity.
